facts.text: I ate a whole cake in the car on the way here. Brake pads, salesmanship and a bit of dessert, that's the trip.
facts.why: Tommy never says this and it is set in quote marks. A real line from the film is 'You know a lot of people go to college for seven years.'
facts.fix: You know a lot of people go to college for seven years.

facts.text: Take the butcher's word for it, Tommy says.
facts.why: Tommy's selling speech is about a guarantee, so trusting a butcher's word runs the other way. I could not open a source for the exact speech.
facts.fix: A guarantee beats the butcher's word, Tommy says.
